verdicts.explanation: The Supplementary Information (Section 1) states that sample 5 (0.35 M LiTFSI in PEGMA/BEMA w/w 3:7 with 2-4 wt% photoinitiator) has σ = 7.9 · 10−6 S/cm, measured by impedance spectroscopy at ambient temperature, which the text ties to the bulk resistance. The UV-curing method, the null temperature in °C, and the null secondary fields are all consistent with the paper.
